info.title: Campus eStudy24 — University ingestion
info.description: Authenticated n8n ingestion. University credentials are scoped to one university. New articles are always pending_review; manual edits and publication decisions are preserved. The legacy server-wide key remains compatible during migration.

post.summary: إنشاء أو تحديث خبر واحد للمراجعة
post.description: 1 MiB maximum JSON. Deduplicated by configured source plus original source_id. Scoped credentials require matching university_slug and source university. 60 requests/minute/key and client bucket.

1 MiB total. Per-record transactions. Check every results entry on HTTP 207. Mixed-university scoped batches are rejected before any import. Retry failed records with the same original IDs; fix rejected records first.

UniversityKey.description: Generate once in private university integration settings. Store in n8n Header Auth credentials. Never put keys in URLs or workflow exports. Owner sessions do not authenticate ingestion.

Url.description: HTTP(S) only; credentials in URLs are forbidden.

source_key.description: Enabled configured source key; defaults to university_slug-rss. This is not a news record ID.

source_id.description: Stable original article ID. Reuse on retries and future source updates.

source_url.description: Original article URL; hostname must match the configured source exactly.

content_text.description: Plain text displayed escaped, never trusted HTML.

published_at.description: Original publication timestamp with timezone; not event or registration date.

Article.description: External media URLs are attributed references, not automatically downloaded/rehosted. status, origin, university_id and administrator fields are forbidden. Missing optional fields default as documented; administrator-edited fields remain protected.

RecordOrError.description: Per-record rejection/failure envelope or a request-level error. Inspect results when present.

Result.description: Per-record created/updated/unchanged/rejected/failed outcomes. Retry only failures with backoff, preserving original IDs.

Error.description: 400 INVALID_JSON; 401 UNAUTHORIZED; 403 UNIVERSITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH; 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; 415 JSON_REQUIRED; 422 INVALID_BATCH/UNKNOWN_SOURCE/SOURCE_HOST_MISMATCH; 429 RATE_LIMITED; 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Do not retry 4xx unchanged; retry 429/503 with bounded exponential backoff.
